author: lavikatiyar
name: pricing
description: Pricing Plan Selection UI that helps users compare subscription tiers. It presents two options — Basic for individuals and small teams with limited features, and Pro for growing teams with advanced tools. Each plan shows price, features, and a user slider that adjusts cost per user, making pricing transparent. The design highlights the Pro plan with a “Popular” tag and a bold CTA button, guiding users toward the upgrade. It’s ideal for SaaS apps offering tiered subscriptions.
